title: Kahana Sunset repair permit appeals
summary: On November 12, the commission voted 5 to allow limited discovery in the Kahana Sunset repair appeals, covering the Building A and F applications and related communications, which the County said it will produce within two weeks. A motion to deny discovery had failed 3–2. The appellants had sought broader discovery, which the applicant's lawyer said spanned 14 broad categories without specific requests.

timeline.text: That motion passed with five votes.
The County said it will produce the documents to the commission and the parties within two weeks.
A commissioner moved to allow discovery of the Building A and F applications and related communications, from the County within two weeks.
A motion to deny discovery failed on a 3–2 vote.
The applicant's lawyer said the request covered 14 broad categories with no specific requests.
The appellants asked for discovery, a process for getting information from other parties before the hearing.
The commission held a prehearing conference on appeals about repairs at Kahana Sunset.
The commission delayed its decision on discovery (collecting evidence from other parties) until November 12.
